findings.summary: Schaerr Jaffe served as outside counsel for Texas AG Ken Paxton in his investigation of Media Matters for America, which had published research showing X placed ads alongside white nationalist content. The firm was paid by Texas taxpayers (K+ in Dec 2023 alone) to defend a state investigation widely seen as retaliatory against critics of Musk's X platform. DC Circuit ruled the investigation violated First Amendment. This is the same firm simultaneously representing Musk/X in other cases.

findings.summary: Comprehensive client pattern: Schaerr Jaffe serves as legal infrastructure for conservative movement across multiple fronts: (1) X/Musk free speech litigation (multiple cases). (2) Republican AG outside counsel (TX-Paxton, IN-Rokita). (3) Anti-vax mandate class actions (United Airlines ~2000 employees, Air Force service members). (4) Special counsel constitutionality (Meese/Cannon brief killed Trump docs case). (5) Religious freedom (Hobby Lobby connection via Hannah Smith/Becket Fund, numerous amicus briefs). (6) Anti-trans (US v Skrmetti amicus). (7) FARA foreign agent for Cayman Islands. (8) States defending election laws, pro-life legislation.

Schaerr Jaffe serves as Elon Musk/X Corp's go-to litigation firm for free speech defense. Known cases: (1) Gina Carano v. Disney — funded by X Corp's Legal Defense Fund, settled Aug 2025. (2) Juan David Campolargo — college student defended pro bono via X. (3) Michelle Evans — Texas GOP activist transgender photo case (Aug 2025). (4) X v. New York (Stop Hiding Hate Act, 2025). (5) X v. DOJ nondisclosure orders — won at DC Circuit. This creates a direct relationship between the firm and Musk while its former partner Paoletta works with Musk's DOGE at OMB.

evidence.evidence_ref: Bloomberg Law, Deadline, Washington Times, Al Jazeera reporting

findings.summary: Schaerr Jaffe is deeply embedded in the Federalist Society network. Erik Jaffe chairs the FedSoc Free Speech & Election Law Practice Group. Multiple partners participate in FedSoc events. Key personnel connections: Gene Schaerr clerked for Scalia and Burger; Erik Jaffe clerked for Justice Thomas; Hannah Smith clerked for Justices Thomas and Alito; Bartolomucci was Bush 43 Associate WH Counsel; Brian Field was Bush 43 DOD appointee; Ken Klukowski was Trump 1 DOJ appointee. Academic affiliate Thomas R. Lee is brother of Sen. Mike Lee (R-UT).

Schaerr Jaffe registered as FARA foreign agent on Jan 22, 2025 (Reg #7526) to represent the Ministry of Financial Services and Commerce, Cayman Islands Government. The timing coincides with the start of the second Trump administration.

Negative results: No SEC EDGAR filings mentioning Schaerr Jaffe. No federal contracts in USASpending. No SAM.gov registration (API key unavailable). No corporate registry entries. No OpenSanctions matches. No GLEIF/LEI records. No ICIJ offshore records. CourtListener shows no Schaerr Jaffe as named party (only appears in counsel records). Limited direct defense tech connections — firm's involvement is through conservative legal movement, not direct defense contracts.
